universe.symbol_order_note: Order is the live loop order and the same-timestamp tie-break in the backtester.

data_source.feed_evidence: feed=iex is sent explicitly by src/historical_download.py and by the live src/broker_alpaca.py.
data_source.adjustment_evidence: Sent explicitly as adjustment=raw. Verified 2026-09-24: NVDA 2024-06-07 bars are ~1190 USD raw vs ~118.6 with adjustment=split, so stored prices and volumes are NOT split-adjusted (NVDA 10:1 split on 2024-06-10 is a raw discontinuity).
data_source.sessions: All bars returned by the API are stored, including pre-market and after-hours. The strategy only decides when the decision instant is inside 09:30-16:00 America/New_York.
data_source.timestamps: UTC, ISO-8601 with Z; each timestamp is the bar START (a 1Min bar at 13:35Z covers [13:35, 13:36)).
data_source.missing_minutes: IEX bars are trade-based: a minute with no IEX trade has no bar. Missing minutes are expected and are never filled or invented.
data_source.plan_notes: Rate limit header reports 200 requests/min. A probe on 2026-09-24 also returned SIP bars for 2023-12-01, but SIP is not used because the live bot trades on IEX data.

splits.name: warmup
splits.purpose: Indicator warm-up and data support only. No results are reported for this window.

splits.name: development
splits.purpose: May be used to form and tune hypotheses.

splits.name: validation
splits.purpose: May be used only after a strategy version and its parameters are frozen. One look per frozen version.

splits.name: known_diagnostic
splits.purpose: Known diagnostic period. Already examined extensively; never untouched out-of-sample data.

splits.name: forward
splits.purpose: Chronological paper/live observations only, recorded as they occur.

benchmark_strategy.parameters_source: Exact run_paper defaults (build_arg_parser with no flags); see config/strategy_versions_v1.json.

contamination_notes: 2026-06-01 -> 2026-09-23 was used to build and validate the portfolio backtester, confirmed-fill accounting, MFE/MAE diagnostics, Entry Quality Diagnostics v1 and Execution Sensitivity v1.
Its results (e.g. 544 trades, PF 0.65, negative even at 0 bps) have shaped our understanding of the system, so any model selected after seeing them is implicitly fit to this window.
It may be used for diagnostics and as a benchmark reference, but MUST NOT be described or used as validation or untouched out-of-sample data.
hygiene_rules: Never tune on validation after viewing validation results.
If parameters change after validation was viewed, create a new strategy version; validation is contaminated for that version.
The known diagnostic period remains contaminated permanently.
Forward paper observations must remain chronological and are never back-filled or re-selected.
Do not select symbols because they performed well in validation.
Do not repeatedly rerun validation while tweaking parameters.
Report development, validation, contaminated and forward evidence separately; never merge them into one score.
